review_candidates.title: Head of Technology
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Position The Opportunity… At Moët Hennessy, We Don't Just Create Exceptional Experiences - We Live Them. As the Head of Technology, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing the technological vision and strategy for the APAC region. You will be responsible for leading and mentoring a high-performing team, driving innovation, overseeing the development and implementation of cutting-edge solutions, and ensuring the robust and scalable operation of all technology platforms. You will be responsible for defining and driving the strategic technological roadmap, ensuring the scalability, security, and reliability of all technology platforms within the APAC region.
